label: Светлый / Тёмный
description: Oppositional adjective drill: светлый vs тёмный across gender, number, the comparatives светлее/темнее, and impersonal светло/темно.

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Masculine light. 1. 'Светлый' agrees with masculine 'день'. 2. Hard-stem masculine ending -ый. 3. The base form of the pair, here in a full sentence.
Strategic focus: Masculine dark. 1. 'Тёмный' agrees with masculine 'лес'. 2. The ё is mandatory in the positive form. 3. Mirrors 'светлый день'.
Strategic focus: Feminine light. 1. 'Светлая' takes the feminine ending -ая. 2. It agrees with 'комната'. 3. Feminine counterpart of 'светлый'.
Strategic focus: Feminine dark. 1. 'Тёмная' takes the feminine ending -ая. 2. The ё stays in the positive form. 3. Agrees with soft-sign feminine 'ночь'.
Strategic focus: Neuter light. 1. 'Светлое' takes the neuter ending -ое. 2. It agrees with 'небо'. 3. Neuter member of the set.
Strategic focus: Neuter dark. 1. 'Тёмное' takes the neuter ending -ое. 2. The ё is kept in the positive form. 3. Agrees with neuter 'пятно'.
Strategic focus: Plural light. 1. 'Светлые' takes the plural ending -ые. 2. It agrees with plural 'волосы'. 3. Number, not gender, drives this form.
Strategic focus: Plural dark. 1. 'Тёмные' takes the plural ending -ые. 2. The ё remains in the positive plural. 3. Agrees with plural-only 'очки'.

missions.phrase: К утру на улице стало светлее.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Comparative brighter. 1. 'Светлее' is the comparative of 'светлый'. 2. It is invariable. 3. Contrast with the base 'светлый'.
Strategic focus: Comparative darker. 1. 'Темнее' is the comparative of 'тёмный'. 2. Critically, it loses the ё and uses е. 3. Contrast with positive 'тёмный'.
Strategic focus: Impersonal light. 1. 'Светло' is an impersonal predicative. 2. No noun to agree with. 3. States ambient brightness, not a thing.
Strategic focus: Impersonal dark. 1. 'Темно' is the impersonal predicative. 2. Note it uses е, not ё. 3. Describes ambient darkness.
